scenarios.title: Local synthetic email session lifecycle
plannedActions: Run through Tracer with the reviewed local runtime and an in-process synthetic email RPC mailbox, real loopback Worker and original D1 migrations.
POST /auth/email/request synthetic address and proof challenge
POST /auth/email/request same address and proof during cooldown
POST /auth/email/request same synthetic account second device proof
POST /auth/email/verify second device proof and code
DELETE /auth/sessions second device from first device
expectedOutcomes: Returns a challenge and expiry, and delivers exactly one synthetic mailbox code.
Enforces resend cooldown without a second delivery.
Rejects the correct code with a mismatched proof key.
Issues a session for the normalized synthetic email after successful proof.
Rejects reuse of the consumed challenge.
Reads the issued identity and empty initial team and project lists.
Lists the active session and device name.
Issues a second challenge for the same synthetic account and another proof key.
Issues a second device session for the existing user.
Lists both device sessions and identifies the current session.
Revokes the second device session from the first.
Lists only the still-active first session after revocation.
